query: SELECT holders.user_id AS "user_id!: Uuid", COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT actor.user_id FROM role_binding INNER JOIN actor ON actor.id = role_binding.actor_id INNER JOIN "user" ON actor.user_id = "user".id WHERE role_binding.workspace_id = $1 AND role_binding.role_id = $2 AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".username ILIKE '%' || $3::TEXT || '%') AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".first_name ILIKE '%' || $4::TEXT || '%') AND ($5::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".last_name ILIKE '%' || $5::TEXT || '%')) holders ORDER BY holders.user_id LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7;
